text:
<summary>
1. Goal and done-criteria: Update parse.py to expose datetime C standard format codes via `dt_format_to_regex`, fix Parser for single-digit days/months/colons/%z, add `formatter` property, support hyphens in field names, group chars in decimals, expose API names. Hidden tests check these; existing tests must pass.

2. Constraints and rules: 120s per python call. 8192 char output cut. All existing tests must keep passing. Write STATUS.json at repo root.

3. User messages: TASK describes requirements [R1]-[R6]. No other messages.

4. Entities touched:
   - `parse.py`: Modified __all__ (line ~477), added formatter property (~after line 879), updated _to_group_name (line 1012-1031) for hyphens, updated PARSE_RE (line 797) for hyphens, updated %n regex (line 1088) for group chars.
   - `test_parse.py`: Not modified yet.
   - `STATUS.json`: To be written at end.

5. Pending items:
   - [R1] dt_format_to_regex function not implemented
   - [R1] Single-digit day/month handling in time patterns
   - [R1] Colon support in time formats  
   - [R1] Flexible %z parsing
   - [R1] Python 2 timezone shielding
   - [R4] %f directive needs variable digit length support
   - [R5] Need verification that hyphen handling is complete
   - [R6] %n regex updated but need to test

6. Errors and fixes: None yet. All edits succeeded.

7. Current hypothesis: The main work is implementing dt_format_to_regex from scratch based on C strftime codes, updating TIME_PAT/TZ_PAT for flexibility, fixing %f pattern, and ensuring everything passes tests.

8. Next step: Implement dt_format_to_regex, update time patterns for single-digit support and colons, fix %f pattern, then run tests.

9. Variables worth remembering:
   - PARSE_RE: Updated to `[\\w-]*` instead of `\\w*`
   - _to_group_name: Now replaces '-' with '_'
   - %n regex: Updated to `\d{1,3}([,.]\d{3})*`
</summary>
